description: Na₂ZrF₆ is Baddeleyite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent ZrF₇ pentagonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and edges with two equivalent ZrF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.47 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.67 Å. Zr is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted ZrF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ZrF₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and edges with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Zr-F bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.20 Å. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na and one Zr atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Zr atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Zr atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Zr trigonal pyramids. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Zr atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Zr atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Zr tetrahedra. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Zr atom.
